domestic_evidence: Company investor page (aymsyntex.com/investors) states: "Exports as a % to Revenue 17% to 45% Increase in share over the last 12 years" and "Annual Revenue 12.5% CAGR Growth over the last 12 years" — i.e. the company itself reports that the majority (55-83%) of revenue is non-export, i.e. domestic Indian sales. It is a listed public limited company with manufacturing facilities in India (including the Jammu unit) and a published annual-report/quarterly-results section, which implies GST-registered domestic turnover. Exact rupee turnover figure and GSTIN not retrieved: screener.in returned HTTP 404 and moneycontrol returned HTTP 403, so revenue value = null (not invented). No GeM/CPPP tender award record was located (web_search tool was down: "searx: Connection refused").
note: Legal entity exists and is active: AYM Syntex Limited, listed Indian polyester/nylon filament yarn manufacturer (BCF yarns, textile yarns, packaged dyed yarns), with a Jammu unit. Export shipments are factually confirmed by dated Indian customs/bill-of-lading records with destination, HS code and BOL number — not merely website claims. Declared HS 540233/540262 is correct (polyester textured/dyed filament yarn) — no HS correction needed. Industry claim "Продукты питания и FMCG" is wrong: actual industry is synthetic filament yarn / textiles (HS 54), not food/FMCG. Domestic supply is confirmed indirectly via the company's own disclosure that exports are only 17-45% of revenue, meaning the bulk of turnover is domestic; exact revenue and GST turnover band are null because the financial data pages were blocked (404/403) and the search tool was unavailable. No sanctions/court issues were checked or are relevant per project rules. Verdict: accepted, HS confirmed, no rejection grounds.
